targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.symbol,s.period_seconds) s.* FROM pullback_signals s JOIN indicator_symbols a ON a.symbol=s.symbol AND a.active WHERE s.setup_version LIKE 'pullback-1-%' ORDER BY s.symbol,s.period_seconds,s.candle_epoch DESC), valid AS (SELECT s.*,r.state FROM latest s JOIN pullback_registry r ON r.symbol=s.symbol AND r.period_seconds=s.period_seconds AND r.setup_version=s.setup_version WHERE r.state IN ('piloto','ativo') AND s.reason='setup_confirmado' AND s.side IN ('CALL','PUT') AND s.candle_epoch=(extract(epoch from now())::bigint/s.period_seconds)*s.period_seconds-s.period_seconds) SELECT symbol AS ativo,period_seconds AS periodo,side AS sinal,upper(state) AS estado,setup_version AS versao,to_timestamp(candle_epoch+period_seconds) AS vela_fechada FROM valid WHERE symbol=coalesce(nullif(${symbol:sqlstring}, ''), 'OTC_SSMI') AND period_seconds=coalesce(nullif(${period:sqlstring}, '')::integer, 900) ORDER BY candle_epoch DESC

SELECT to_timestamp(candle_epoch+period_seconds) AS horario,side AS sinal,reason AS motivo,setup_version AS versao FROM pullback_signals WHERE symbol=coalesce(nullif(${symbol:sqlstring}, ''), 'OTC_SSMI') AND period_seconds=coalesce(nullif(${period:sqlstring}, '')::integer, 900) AND $__unixEpochFilter(candle_epoch) ORDER BY candle_epoch DESC LIMIT 300

SELECT to_timestamp(date_start) AS horario,account_mode AS conta,direction AS lado,contract_id,round(profit::numeric,2) AS resultado,settlement_source AS fonte FROM contract_executions WHERE symbol=coalesce(nullif(${symbol:sqlstring}, ''), 'OTC_SSMI') AND indicator_period_seconds=coalesce(nullif(${period:sqlstring}, '')::integer, 900) AND indicator_model_version LIKE 'pullback-1-%' AND settlement_source IN ('broker', 'profit_table') AND $__unixEpochFilter(date_start) ORDER BY date_start DESC LIMIT 100
